shots.line: Most people score around a hundred on an IQ test.
Fewer than one in seven hundred score above one hundred and forty-five.

shots.scene: curve, a dot far off the chart

shots.line: No test can even measure that.
Most stop working well before one hundred and sixty.
Your brain is only about two percent of your weight...
yet it burns about twenty percent of your energy.
Running at full power, yours burns far more.
So what if you had a thousand IQ?

shots.line: Rush hour gets twelve minutes shorter.

shots.line: Think too fast for too long, and your skull starts to pound.

shots.line: Your brain has about eighty-six billion neurons.
Yours fire like they’re all late for something.
You sleep twelve hours a night.
But where it gets really crazy... is the weather.

shots.line: You start predicting storms better than the forecast.

shots.line: She invites you to the city’s flood center.

Conversations feel like waiting for a bus.

shots.line: Mom finds you awake at three in the morning, staring at the ceiling.

shots.line: What are you thinking about, sweetheart?
And the more you use your brain, the more it hurts.
and you might not come back the same.
shots.scene: brain meter in the red: DANGER

shots.line: Being smart is easy, you tell her.
Being useful is the hard part.
Only one person treats you like nothing changed.
She thinks your brain is boring.
She wins at hide and seek because you let her.

shots.line: If water’s on the road, you don’t walk through it.

shots.line: The water is climbing about ten centimeters every hour.

Somewhere along twelve kilometers of wall, it’s going to break.
To find out, you’d have to run every piece of data at once.

shots.line: The one thing Dr. Lee told you never to do.

shots.line: Or you could push your brain past its limit...
If you do this, I can’t promise what comes back.
What’s the point of a brain...
Being useful is the hard part.
And you open the floodgates in your head.
Nobody listens to a thirteen-year-old with a hunch.
So you don’t give them a hunch.

shots.line: You can’t remember a single cloud name in Latin.
Being useful is the hard part.

shots.line: Your brain really does use about a fifth of your body’s energy.

Never walk or drive through moving water.
So could anyone ever be a thousand times smarter?
